reason: This plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness Web observability UI: it adds a session-side panel and optional full-screen dashboard to monitor current-session agent/tool activity, token usage, and derived cost estimates using live Harness projection data. Its core user-facing purpose is monitoring and visualization within the DSH interface rather than generating code, automating actions, or managing external data sources.

summaries.zh: Mission Control 是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，用于在当前会话中实时展示代理/工具活动、子代理结构和令牌使用，并提供可选的全屏仪表盘。
summaries.en: Mission Control is a DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that shows live agent and tool activity for the current session, including token usage and an optional full-screen monitoring dashboard.

capabilities: Consumes and displays live session telemetry for agents, tools, and subagents
Subscribes to same-origin event streaming while Mission Control panel is visible
Shows token meter metrics and token-velocity information in dashboard/panel views
Displays optional cost estimates derived from observed token/model usage
Offers configurable tool payload preview modes from names-only to full

reasons.code: Readme describes a live mission-control panel and full-screen dashboard that shows agent tree, tool stream, token buckets, token velocity, and session facts in real time.
Readme states the plugin opens one same-origin SSE subscription to `/plugins/mission-control/events` while visible, and freezes last snapshot on reconnect.
Readme explains previewMode includes a full option that renders complete tool arguments/results, with redaction only as a best-effort privacy control.
Package manifest declares a web plugin client entry with DSH session-projection/token-meter/service injections, indicating it observes existing runtime telemetry rather than altering model behavior.
